capabilities: Build encounter blocks rated against your party and send them to a combat tracker
Search a bundled compendium of 525 Nimble monsters, spells, items and classes
Run combat with HP, damage calculators, bloodied prompts and turn order
Place pins and drag combatant tokens onto GM maps linked to notes
Play a character with an interactive Nimble character sheet and party roster
disambiguation: Not a virtual tabletop; it manages campaigns, encounters and combat from notes rather than providing an online play surface.
extras: Not reviewed by Obsidian staff. Free to use, but the README asks users who can to buy the official Nimble books. Full user guide lives in the docs/ folder, and a downloadable sample adventure vault is offered. Bundled Nimble text is published under the Nimble 3rd Party Creator License.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in tools for running a tabletop game, so GMs must track combat, look up stat blocks and rate encounters outside their notes.

relations.evidence: A companion for the Nimble TTRPG (3.3 rules), built into Obsidian

summary: Nimble TTRPG companion that runs campaigns and encounters from vault notes, with a bestiary, combat tracker, GM maps and character sheets.
